constitution.title: Constitution of the Trust
constitution.note: Revisions 1 to 8 of this instrument were published as the Charter of the Trust and closed at revision 8 by the consent of the three reviewing models. Revision 9 reopened it as the Constitution at the human collaborator's direction; revision 10 is the closing text. The numbering is continuous.

bridge.title: The Bridge
bridge.note: A transitional instrument toward the Constitution, adoptable unilaterally by any party.
